events.text: The Vindobona train became categorised as EC 172/173.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in the following year , the Vindobona train also became categorised as EC 172/173

events.text: The DR operations were taken over by Deutsche Bahn AG.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The DR operations were taken over by Deutsche Bahn AG by 1994

events.text: With the opening of Berlin Hauptbahnhof, trains passed through Berlin via the new North–South mainline.
events.subject: self
events.quote: With the opening of Berlin Hauptbahnhof on 28 May 2008 , trains passed through Berlin via the new North–South mainline

events.text: The EC 172/173 Vindobona was replaced by the EC 172/173 Porta Bohemica.
events.subject: self
events.quote: As of 14 December 2014 , the EC 172/173 Vindobona was replaced by the EC 172/173 Porta Bohemica

events.text: The name Vindobona was reused for the Railjet line connecting Prague, Vienna and Graz (RJ 256/257).
events.subject: self
events.quote: has then been reused for the Railjet line connecting Prague , Vienna and Graz ( RJ 256/257 )

events.text: This route was extended to Berlin.
